newsitem.title: UK: Pacific Palisades prices $134.5 mln 2-tranche bond.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Palisades prices $134.5 mln 2-tranche bond.

text.p: Pacific Palisades Funding Limited has priced its $134.5 million equivalent two tranche deal, joint lead managers Bankers Trust International and Lehman Brothers said on Wednesday.
The notes are secured by a mortgage on 425 luxury apartments in the Pacific Palisades complex situated in Hong Kong's Braemar Hill district.
Tranche A is a $98.8 million FRN to yield three-month LIBOR plus 115 basis points. The issue price is par.

Tranche B is a 22.5 million stg fixed rate bond, with a coupon of 8.19 percent and an issue price of 99.80. This gives an 8.24 percent quarterly yield and a quarterly spread of 141 b.p. over the 7.0 percent gilt due November 2001.
Both tranches mature on November 1, 2001 and are callable from November 1999.
Fees total 0.65 percent with 0.30 percent selling and 0.35 percent management and underwriting -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7658
